description: tangent-outside-cut's tool, touching the plate's side face from outside, moved four tolerances (4e-7) across the contact, into the plate (d > 0) and away from it (d < 0), and turned about the contact's middle so its ends move half a tolerance in and out (t): the plate less a sliver, the plate whole, and the turn the survey's regression fixture held that steps 2 to 5c fixed. A quarter of a tolerance is tangent-outside-a-quarter-off (plans/c3-tolerance-apart step 9, the band's ends).
